_comment: CourtListener v4 opinion search. Two hardcoded invariants (not config knobs): (1) semantic=true; (2) per-row jurisdiction filter to state supreme+appellate (or federal courts for FED rows), mirroring the TrustFoundry provider's body.state filter. Rate limits are fetched live from the CL docs URL at startup; the fallback numbers are only used if that fetch fails or the parse is incomplete.
